Absolutely fantastic experience at Maki & Ramen! This was honestly one of the best Japanese meals we have had, and without a doubt the ramen was the highlight of our visit. It was easily the best ramen I have tried so far. The broth was incredibly rich, full of flavour and perfectly balanced, the noodles were cooked just right, and all the ingredients tasted fresh and high quality. You can really tell that a lot of care goes into preparing every bowl.

The sushi was also excellent. Everything tasted very fresh, the rice had a great texture, and the flavours worked really well together. If you are a sushi lover, this is definitely a place worth trying.

We also ordered the octopus and it was just as good. It was cooked perfectly, very tasty and well seasoned, with a really enjoyable texture. It is not always easy to find octopus prepared properly, but Maki & Ramen did an amazing job with it.

And the meal did not disappoint when it came to dessert either. The dessert was delicious and was the perfect way to finish an already excellent dinner. From the ramen and sushi to the octopus and dessert, everything we tried was consistently good.

The whole experience left a very positive impression on us. If you are looking for a great Japanese restaurant with delicious ramen, fresh sushi, tasty seafood and good desserts, Maki & Ramen is definitely worth visiting. The quality of the food was excellent throughout our meal and the flavours really stood out.

For me personally, the ramen deserves a special mention again because it was genuinely outstanding and the best ramen I have eaten up to now. I would happily come back just for another bowl, although after trying the sushi, octopus and dessert, it would be difficult not to order everything again!

We will definitely be coming back to Maki & Ramen in the future. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys authentic Japanese food, ramen, sushi and beautifully prepared dishes. A great place for a casual meal, lunch or dinner, and definitely somewhere we would recommend to friends and family.
